title: Plate of a single piece, one view (magenta, square)
description: Moodboard P8 (plates): plates of a single piece only, one view per plate, the six views on the wearer's axes, starting with the Helmet front.

body.subject: Plates of a single piece only: {{asset_name}}. One view only: {{view}}. Match the linked reference exactly for proportion, materials, wear and detail.
body.action: Piece centred, occupying about 80% of frame height, with even margin on all sides.
body.camera: VIEW DEFINITION: the view on the wearer's axes, as named. Orthographic projection, or the longest telephoto equivalent. No perspective distortion. Square frame. Highest resolution available.
body.style: PRESENTATION (follow exactly): Flat solid background, pure magenta #FF00FF, edge to edge. No gradient, no vignette, no checkerboard, no drawn transparency pattern. Flat, even, diffuse lighting from the camera direction. No cast shadow, no contact shadow, no ground plane, no rim light, no dramatic key. Minimal specular highlight. Matte material response.
body.constraints: No text, no labels, no captions, no watermark, no props, no set dressing, no hands, no mannequin, no other pieces.

view.default: FRONT (from directly in front of the wearer, looking at their chest)
enum: FRONT (from directly in front of the wearer, looking at their chest)
LEFT (from the wearer's own left side)
RIGHT (from the wearer's own right side)
view.description: one view only, on the WEARER's axes

reference_image.description: the linked reference of the piece
